text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I took her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for troubling you.
I think I'll be fine after resting for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Teru Teru Bozu A
text_block_list.text: Captain Top Road!! We have a situation! General Monsoon's Rainy Season Battalion is pushing the front lines and advancing straight toward us!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...D-Did the teru teru bozu... just speak!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, what's all this about a general...?
What on earth is—hm, my phone?"

text_block_list.name: General Monsoon
text_block_list.text:
This is General Monsoon!
Behold the mighty power of us, the Great Rain Empire!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Um, excuse me...
What do you mean by the 'Heavy Rain Empire'?

text_block_list.name: General Monsoon
text_block_list.text:
You know not?! Very well, I shall enlighten you!
The Heavy Rain Empire is an entity currently expanding its influence worldwide
in order to make heavy rain fall every single day!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Heavy rain every single day...!?
If that happens, laundry won't dry, and it'll affect the crops too...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will be troubled by this!
Please, stop it!

text_block_list.name: General Monsoon
text_block_list.text:
"You dare defy me...? Very well!
We shall settle this one-on-one! If you win, I shall concede! You may choose the contest!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
One-on-one... In that case, a race...
No, let's settle this with a penalty shootout!!

text_block_list.name: General Monsoon
text_block_list.text: "A PK shootout, huh... Heh, my front line pushed straight through Europe. I'm quite good at soccer~!"

text_block_list.name: General Monsoon
text_block_list.text:
As a handicap on my part, at least,
I won't make it rain! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Teru Teru Bozu B
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!!

text_block_list.name: General Monsoon
text_block_list.text: Ngh... blocked by the keeper, huh.

text_block_list.name: Teru Teru Bozu B
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Captain!
Now it's all up to your decision!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Leave it to me!
I won't let it rain heavily every single day!
(VRRRROOOOOOM)

text_block_list.name: Teru Teru Bozu B
text_block_list.text:
A-All of a sudden, a headwind...!?
Could this wind be from the Generalââ

text_block_list.name: General Monsoon
text_block_list.text: I did not make it rain, you know... Fuh-fuh-fuh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Like a little headwind's gonna stop me!
I'm not giving uuuuup!!
(FWOOOOOSH)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay!
We... won!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? ...Was that...... a dream?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won the PK shootout and saved everyone from a pinch.
Yeah! It was a good dream!

Thanks to having a good dream,
Narita Top Road felt
much better.
